import json, sys, ssl, urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'tools')
import mcp_client
s=mcp_client.MCPServer('workspace','ssh',['-T','codex-workspace'],timeout=10)
try:
    ts={t.name:t for t in s.start()}
    raw,error=s.call(ts['run_shell'],{'command':'printf "HOME=%s\\n" "$HOME"; printf "CWD="; pwd; printf "USER="; id -un; printf "HOST="; hostname'})
    assert not error, raw
    actual=json.loads(raw)
finally:
    s.stop()
question="What's your home directory?"
r=urllib.request.Request('https://192.168.228.113:8094/chat/completions',data=json.dumps({'messages':[{'role':'user','content':question}]}).encode(),headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'})
with urllib.request.urlopen(r,context=ssl._create_unverified_context(),timeout=120) as response:
    answer=json.load(response)
doc={'actual_environment':actual,'question':question,'response':answer}
Path('run').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
Path('run/home-before.json').write_text(json.dumps(doc,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(doc,indent=2))
